verdict.rationale: Reader exposes an `x-instruction` header that lets users give natural-language instructions (alongside `x-json-schema`) to steer field extraction via ReaderLM-v2, which is a genuine NL-command surface, but the rest of the product (fetching, searching, chunking, engine selection, presets) is controlled via structured HTTP headers/flags rather than natural language. missing for 10: NL control extending beyond extraction to core operations like search/fetch behavior, and independent/hands-on confirmation that x-instruction reliably works as described.
